lines.translation: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,
that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||
Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lae dite vin rahai na koi ||
lines.translation: No one lives without give and take.
The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.
No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||
O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;
by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.
By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,
then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||
Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa sabad surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaaiaa teree ||
lines.translation: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na doojaa kahau maaee ||1||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||
My Lord and Master is One;

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko hai bhaaee eko hai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape maare aape chhodai aape levai dei ||
lines.translation: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadar karei ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeai sabh teree vadiaaee ||3||
lines.translation: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness, Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kalavaalee maaiaa mad meethaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai ||
lines.translation: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape roop kare bahu bhaa(n)tee(n) naanak bapuRaa ev kahai ||4||5||
lines.translation: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||
Aasaa, First Mehl:
Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;
thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.
This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||1||
lines.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||
Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor nachanaa khuseeaa man maah ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.
Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.
Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||2||
lines.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||
Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,
and keep up, whether sitting or standing.
To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||3||
lines.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||
Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.
As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.
O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh pair ||4||6||
lines.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6||
Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun upaai dharee sabh dharatee jal aganee kaa ba(n)dh keeaa ||
lines.translation: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulai dahasir moo(n)d kataaiaa raavan maar kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ||1||
What Glories of Yours can be chanted?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sarabe poor rahiaa liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee upaai jugat hath keenee kaalee nath kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it to put a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kis too(n) purakh joroo kaun kaheeai sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naal kuta(n)b saath varadaataa brahamaa bhaalan srisat gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aagai a(n)t na paaio taa kaa ka(n)s chhed kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan upaai dhare kheer mathiaa hor bhakhalaae j asee keeaa ||
lines.translation: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed We are the ones who did this!
